meta.devflowDescription: AI engineering collaboration workspace: GitHub issues, pull requests, CI debugging, knowledge base and reports.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.descriptionEmpty: Connect a GitHub repository to unlock AI triage, PR review, CI debugging and a per-repo knowledge base.
dashboard.noReposDescription: DevFlow analyzes issues, pull requests and CI runs from your GitHub repositories.

issues.title: Issue Triage
issues.descriptionRepo: AI classification, priority, owner suggestion and next actions for {repo}
issues.descriptionNone: Select a repository to browse its issues
issues.empty: No issues found. Sync the repository first.
issues.selectPrompt: Select an issue to see details and run AI triage.
issues.draftCreated: Action draft created — review it on the Drafts page
issues.noAnalysisDescription: Run AI triage to classify this issue, suggest an owner, find duplicates and produce next actions.

similar.title: Similar issues
similar.empty: No similar issues found. Build the GitHub content index on the Knowledge page first.
similar.unavailable: Vector search is unavailable, so similar issues cannot be computed right now. Check Milvus and the GitHub content index.

pulls.title: PR Review
pulls.descriptionRepo: AI review of changes, risks, blocking findings and test suggestions for {repo}
pulls.descriptionNone: Select a repository to browse its pull requests
pulls.empty: No pull requests found. Sync the repository first.
pulls.selectPrompt: Select a pull request to inspect its changes and run an AI review.
pulls.reviewCommentDrafted: Review comment drafted — confirm it on the Drafts page
pulls.generatedNote: _Generated by DevFlow AI. Please verify before acting._
pulls.noReviewDescription: Run an AI review to get graded findings (P1–P3), risks, a merge recommendation and test suggestions.

checklist.dialogDescription: PR #{number} — deterministic checks over changed files, CI status and review state, no LLM involved.
checklist.dialogDescriptionGeneric: Deterministic checks over changed files, CI status and review state, no LLM involved.
checklist.noFindings: No findings from the deterministic checks.

ci.title: CI / Actions
ci.descriptionRepo: Workflow runs of {repo}. Failed runs carry logs for AI debugging.
ci.descriptionNone: Select a repository to browse its CI runs
ci.empty: No workflow runs found. Sync the repository first.
ci.selectPrompt: Select a workflow run to inspect its jobs and debug failures.
ci.noDebugDescription: Debug with AI to get the first error, root cause, concrete fix steps and further investigation hints.

knowledge.title: Knowledge Base
knowledge.descriptionRepo: Documents, retrieval tests and evidence-grounded QA for {repo}. Vectors live in Milvus (dense + BM25 hybrid).
knowledge.descriptionNone: Select a repository to manage its knowledge base
knowledge.connectFirst: Connect and select a repository first.
knowledge.dropTitle: Drop files here or browse to upload
knowledge.dropHint: Markdown, text, JSON, CSV, logs and source files up to 5 MB. Duplicate content is skipped by SHA-256.
knowledge.noDocuments: No documents yet — weekly reports also land here automatically.
knowledge.deleteDescription: The document and all of its vector chunks will be removed from the knowledge base.
knowledge.hitsSummary: {count} hits in {ms} ms — scores are RRF fusion values (higher is better, relative ordering matters).
knowledge.noHits: No hits — try a different query or upload more documents.
knowledge.question: Question
knowledge.questionPlaceholder: Ask anything about this repository’s knowledge base…

config.title: Retrieval settings
config.description: Per-repository defaults applied to retrieval tests, knowledge search, Q&A and upload chunking.
config.notStored: No stored config yet — showing code defaults.
config.rerankHint: Re-rank fused candidates; falls back to the local heuristic when no rerank API key is configured.
config.overlapInvalid: Chunk overlap must be smaller than the chunk size.
config.scoreThresholdHint: Filter out results whose absolute dense (COSINE) similarity is below the threshold before answering.

test.historyFill: Fill this query into the test input

contentIndex.title: GitHub content index
contentIndex.description: Vectorizes synced issues, pull requests and failed CI logs; powers similar-issue lookup on the Issues page and recall in agent chat.
contentIndex.empty: Nothing indexed yet — sync the repository, then rebuild.
contentIndex.result: Indexed {items} items into {chunks} chunks in {ms} ms.

knowledge.chunksDescription: The exact chunks stored in Milvus for this document, in index order.
knowledge.noChunks: No chunks are indexed for this document yet.
knowledge.noteContentPlaceholder: Write a note to store in this repo's knowledge base…
knowledge.noteNeedsContent: Provide a title or content for the note.

code.title: Code
code.descriptionRepo: Source checkout, code search, and project-doc index for {repo}
code.descriptionNone: Select a repository to work with its source code
code.notCloned: The repository code is not cloned to this server yet. Cloning creates a shallow checkout used by the file tools and search.
code.noCheckoutDescription: Clone the repository to browse files, search the code, and index the project docs.
code.searchPlaceholder: Search the code, e.g. a function name, string, or config key…
code.noMatches: No matches. Try a different term.

agentChat.title: Agent Chat
agentChat.descriptionRepo: Tool-calling agent over {repo}: issues, PRs, CI runs, knowledge base and safe action drafts.
agentChat.descriptionNone: Select a repository to chat with its data
agentChat.askAnythingDescription: The agent grounds every answer in synced data via tools, and proposes GitHub writes only as confirmable drafts.
agentChat.sample1: Why did the latest CI run fail?
agentChat.sample2: Summarize the risks of the newest open PR
agentChat.sample3: Which open issues look like duplicates?
agentChat.sample4: What does the knowledge base say about deployment?
agentChat.sample5: Draft a triage comment for the oldest open issue
agentChat.inputPlaceholder: Ask the agent… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
agentChat.feedbackDescription: Your feedback helps improve the agent. Negative feedback opens a review and can notify the team.
agentChat.memorySummaryEmpty: No sealed memory yet. Memories build automatically as conversations grow.
agentChat.candidateApproved: Candidate approved into the knowledge base
agentChat.candidateApprovedKbFailed: Candidate approved, but knowledge-base indexing failed

reports.title: Weekly Reports
reports.descriptionRepo: Generate an engineering weekly for {repo} from synced issues, PRs and CI runs.
reports.descriptionNone: Select a repository to generate its weekly report
reports.invalidRange: Start date must be before end date.
reports.generated: Weekly report generated and saved to the knowledge base
reports.noReportDescription: Pick a date range and generate — the report covers completed work, risks, PRs needing attention, failed CI and next-week suggestions.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.descriptionNone: Select a repository to review chat feedback
feedback.noFeedbackDescription: Rate answers in Agent Chat to build the review queue.
feedback.question: Question
feedback.reviewFeedbackDescription: Resolve or dismiss this negative feedback with an optional note.

drafts.title: Action Drafts
drafts.description: Every GitHub write proposed by AI lands here as a draft. Review the content, then execute or reject — nothing is posted without your confirmation.
drafts.selectPrompt: Select a draft to review its content.
drafts.confirmDescriptionPlain: This performs a real write against {repo}. This cannot be undone from DevFlow.
drafts.confirmDescriptionTarget: This performs a real write against {repo} on #{number}. This cannot be undone from DevFlow.

repos.title: Repositories
repos.description: Connected GitHub repositories and their sync state. Sync pulls issues, pull requests, review comments and CI logs.
repos.noReposDescription: Connect a repository to start analyzing its issues, pull requests and CI runs with AI.

connect.title: Connect a repository
connect.description: DevFlow verifies the repository through the GitHub API, then runs an initial sync of issues, pull requests and CI runs.
connect.tokenDescription: Stored encrypted. Required for private repos; raises rate limits for public ones.
connect.ownerRepoRequired: Owner and repository name are required.
connect.localHint: Owner and repository are read from the git remote; GitHub data still syncs through the API.
connect.cloneParentDirHint: Where the managed clone lives; defaults to the workspace root.

delete.title: Delete {repo}?
delete.description: This removes the repository along with its synced issues, pull requests, CI runs, knowledge documents and action drafts. The GitHub repository itself is not touched.

analysis.ownerValidationReplaced: Suggested owner {original} is not in the allow-list; kept the rule-based suggestion {final}.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Group repositories into workspaces to aggregate engineering statistics and generate cross-repository weekly reports.

workflowRuns.title: Workflow Runs
workflowRuns.descriptionRepo: Multi-agent workflow orchestration for {repo}: plan bounded claims, execute the analyses, and synthesize a decision memo.
workflowRuns.descriptionNone: Select a repository to start a multi-agent workflow.
workflowRuns.goalPlaceholder: e.g. Can we ship this release? Each agent stays inside its claimed entity.

graph.title: Knowledge Graph
graph.description: Relation network derived from synced issues, PRs, members, documents and conversations
graph.noRepo: Connect a repository first to view its knowledge graph.
graph.emptyGraph: No graph edges yet. Sync the repository, then rebuild the graph.
graph.selectNodeHint: Select a node to explore its neighborhood

analyzeStream.contextPull: Read PR #{number} "{title}" — {files} changed file(s), {comments} review comment(s).
analyzeStream.contextRun: Read workflow run "{name}" — status {status}, conclusion {conclusion}, {jobs} job(s), {logChars} log char(s).
analyzeStream.rulesNote: The deterministic rule engine, LLM enrichment and merge run as one unit inside the analysis orchestrator; their stage boundaries are not separately observable (coarse-grained trace).
analyzeStream.llmSkipped: LLM enrichment unavailable or failed; the deterministic baseline is used as-is (generationMode=deterministic).
analyzeStream.mergedLlm: LLM fields merged over the rule baseline; persisted as AnalysisResult {id}.
analyzeStream.mergedDeterministic: Rule baseline persisted as-is as AnalysisResult {id}.

codeGraph.title: Code Graph
codeGraph.descriptionRepo: Symbols, relations and one-hop change impact extracted from the {repo} checkout
codeGraph.descriptionNone: Select a repository to explore its code graph
codeGraph.searchPlaceholder: Search symbols by name or path…
codeGraph.noSymbols: No symbols found. Rebuild the graph or adjust the filters.
codeGraph.emptyDescription: Rebuild to extract symbols (functions, classes, types) and imports/calls/defines relations from the checkout.
codeGraph.impactDescription: Given changed files, list their symbols and the other files/symbols that depend on them.
codeGraph.impactNone: No symbols found in the given files, or nothing depends on them.
